Defcribitur Ecclefia duabus fuis partibus
effentialibus (vt omnibus rebus fieri folet)
cùm domus Jehoua appellatur. Nam quà domus,
materia fignificatur: quà Jehoua domus, forma
effentialis huic materiæ indita.

page.notes: Handwritten "136" in the top right margin is not printed and is left out. The left edge shows bleed-through and page edge, left out. Long s is written as plain s throughout. Initial I of Jehoua, Jefu and jacentes is written as J because it is a consonant. The final word of the page is cut as "pof-" and completed by the catchword "funt".
